Scope Gate.decided_by: operator vuhoangcao on behalf of omn-business-analyst
Scope Gate.rationale: Scope bounded: 9 in-scope items trace to the feature request and change request, 8 exclusions name every non-goal by name, 14 testable acceptance criteria each bound a scope item, 0 blocking open questions; the three non-blocking questions are answerable by the requester and tech lead before the Review Gate. omn-product-owner produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Planning Gate.decided_by: operator vuhoangcao on behalf of omn-tech-lead
Planning Gate.rationale: Plan validates 45 of 45 after one charged repair that cleared two missing task acceptance criteria and seven capability names drawn from matrix column headings rather than declared identifiers. 14 tasks over 5 waves, an acyclic edge table from which the stated order recomputes, 10 risks each attached to a task, 0 blocking open questions. The decomposition leaves carrier-file selection to the design phase rather than presuming it, which keeps the structural decision with its owner. planner produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Design Gate.decided_by: operator vuhoangcao on behalf of omn-tech-lead
Design Gate.rationale: Design validates 78 of 78 after one charged repair. Four options evaluated against every recorded constraint with the selection re-derivable from the table: extending the existing architecture skill in place is the only candidate satisfying both hard constraints, and a new dedicated file was eliminated on the no-new-file constraint and on reachability, which is the policy under design applied to its own delivery. One architecture-significant decision carries a record at Proposed, and that record is accepted at this gate. Q-001 is answered: the implementation phase performs the repository writes, because the implementer is the only agent whose authority scope reaches repository source and the architect's own invariant 1 forbids it. Q-002 is answered: the skill specification makes MINOR the rule for additive guidance, no rule is removed or restructured, so 1.1.0 stands. Q-003 stays open for a later governance change and blocks nothing here. architect produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Review Gate.decided_by: operator vuhoangcao on behalf of omn-qa
Review Gate.rationale: Review package validates 31 of 31 and returned approve-with-corrections over 2 high and 1 medium finding. Both blocking correction requests are closed and re-verified before this decision, and the review earned its keep: it independently caught that an accepted design element, the reviewer's own Stage 4 extension, had been silently skipped with no deviation recorded, which is the exact failure the framework's evidence rules exist to catch. That element is now implemented in 10 lines inside the existing maintainability lens, changing no severity table, no category vocabulary, and no other module. The packaging mirror is refreshed over all 9 changed files and the unit suite is back to 329 of 329, confirmed twice independently. The medium finding on the report's misattribution of write scope is upheld and traced to its real cause, a runtime prompt-rendering defect that displays a repository-wide grant as framework-only; it is recorded as a follow-up defect rather than repaired here, because this change is forbidden from touching the runtime. Its correction cannot be applied to the implementation report, which is immutable committed evidence, so it is carried into closure instead. omn-dev-2-reviewer produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Verification Gate.decided_by: operator vuhoangcao on behalf of omn-qa
Verification Gate.rationale: Every recorded baseline is met on a quiet tree with no concurrent run: registry coverage 6 of 6 with 37 of 37 phases dispatchable, validators 6 of 6, manifests 2 of 2, vertical slice 10 of 10, multi-phase 15 of 15, recovery 41 of 41, and the unit suite 329 of 329 confirmed by two independent executions. The review's monitoring item, a validator verifier reported at 5 of 6 during the review, does not reproduce: three separate executions on a quiet tree return 6 of 6, and the discrepancy is attributed to concurrent execution rather than to this change, which touches nothing under the governance records that check reads. Component counts are unchanged at 12 active agents, 12 skills, 8 workflows, 37 phases, and 11 commands; the runtime module is untouched and its version constant stays 0.5.0. The change set is 9 framework files and their packaging mirror, adding 5,608 bytes of instruction text, which grows the three affected agent module sets by between 0.53 and 1.48 percent and leaves planner, product owner, and QA untouched.

Closure Gate.decided_by: operator vuhoangcao on behalf of omn-orchestrator
Closure Gate.rationale: Six phases executed, six artifacts accepted by their registered validators, five prior gates decided by owners who did not produce the evidence they assessed. Four charged retries are recorded with what each repaired: a plan missing two task acceptance criteria and quoting capability matrix column headings rather than declared identifiers, a design with eight contract findings, and a release note whose version field carried a label rather than a bare version string. Two host failures were recovered through the runtime's own path without losing evidence, an adapter terminated by an organization spend limit and an adapter that stalled during bootstrap. The review found a real defect, an accepted design element silently skipped with no deviation recorded, and both blocking corrections were closed and re-verified before the Review Gate was decided. Every verifier is at its recorded baseline and the unit suite is at 329 of 329, confirmed twice independently. Three items stay open and are recorded rather than closed: the runtime prompt-rendering defect that displays a repository-wide write grant as framework-only, and the two version-classification questions the design left to the tech lead. omn-documentation produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.
